Method of Attack: Exploits Microsoft Exchange ProxyShell vulnerabilities (CVE-2021-34473 and CVE-2021-34523) to gain unauthenticated remote code execution

Uses embedded dictionary, XOR decryption algorithm, and XOR key from remote server
Executes embedded code modules via C# compiler CSC.exe with InMemory compile parameters
Downloads and uses DC_DLL for decryption of additional files
Creates scheduled task for persistence triggered on user login
Injects cryptocurrency miner (XMRig) into browser process memory via process hollowing
Selects random mining pool from hardcoded list for mining activity
Creates firewall rule blocking all outgoing traffic to evade detection
Attack Vector: Exploitation of ProxyShell vulnerabilities in Microsoft Exchange
Remote code execution leading to malware deployment on domain controller
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of .NET malware payload in NETLOGON folder
Scheduled task configured to run on user login
File named DC_DLL downloaded and used for decryption
Firewall rule blocking all outgoing traffic on Windows Firewall profiles
Use of XMRig miner component with special command line parameter
